items.title: 2.2.1.5 Handling Integer and Float Inputs (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of integer and float input (PDF 37).

blocks.text: input() hamesha text (string) deta hai. Number chahiye ho to us text ko badalna parta hai: integer (poora number) ke liye int() aur decimal number ke liye float().

# Example : Handling integer input
user_age = int(input("Enter your age: "))
print("Your age is:",user_age)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"# Example : Handling integer input": comment, chalta nahi.
"input("Enter your age: ")": user se age poochhta hai; jo bhi likha jaye woh text (string) hota hai, maslan "17".
"int(...)": us text ko integer (poora number) mein badal deta hai, taake us par hisaab ho sake.
"print("Your age is:",user_age)": number ko message ke saath dikhata hai.
Output: user 17 likhe to "Your age is: 17". Agar user koi aisa text likhe jo number nahi (maslan abc ya 17.5), to int() ValueError deta hai.
Maslan user 17 likhe to output "Your age is: 17" hoga, aur user_age ab number 17 hai, text nahi.

#   Example: Handling float input
user_height = float(input("Enter your height in meters: ") )
print("Your height is", user_height,"meter")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"#   Example: Handling float input": comment, chalta nahi.
"input("Enter your height in meters: ")": user se height poochhta hai; jawab text hota hai, maslan "1.75".
"float(...)": text ko float (decimal wala number) mein badal deta hai.
"print("Your height is", user_height,"meter")": commas ke beech spaces lagte hain.
Output: user 1.75 likhe to "Your height is 1.75 meter". User 2 likhe to bhi float banta hai: "Your height is 2.0 meter".
Maslan user 1.75 likhe to output "Your height is 1.75 meter" hoga.

blocks.prompt: Agar program int(input(...)) chalaye aur user 1.75 likhe to kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: int() text '1.75' ko nahi badal sakta, to Python ValueError deti hai; decimal values ke liye float(input(...)) istemal karna chahiye.

blocks.text: input() se aane wala data text hota hai, jaise age_text aur height_text. Program dikhata hai ke text jorne aur number jorne mein kya farq hai; dono values badal kar (maslan "20" aur "1.6") Run karein.

age_text = "17"       # input() se aisa text milta hai
height_text = "1.75"
print("Text jor kar:", age_text + age_text)
age = int(age_text)
height = float(height_text)
print("int() ke baad jor kar:", age + age)
print("float() ke baad height x 2:", height * 2)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"age_text = "17"" aur "height_text = "1.75"": quotes ki wajah se yeh numbers nahi, text hain; input() bhi aisa hi text deta hai.
"age_text + age_text": do strings par + unhein saath jor deta hai (joint), hisaab nahi karta: "17" + "17" = "1717".
"age = int(age_text)": text "17" ko integer 17 mein badla.
"height = float(height_text)": text "1.75" ko float 1.75 mein badla.
"age + age": ab asal jama: 17 + 17 = 34.
"height * 2": 1.75 * 2 = 3.5.
Output: "Text jor kar: 1717", "int() ke baad jor kar: 34" aur "float() ke baad height x 2: 3.5".
Khud try karein: age_text = "20" kar ke Run karein: pehli line "2020" aur doosri 40 degi.

items: input() text deta hai; int() se integer (poora number), float() se decimal number banta hai.
